bar.primaryMetric: verified rate (completion) on the ms-long-v1 tasks, graded by the independent grader (multi-step-grader/1) on the final captured document. Both arms' rows are gated rows (spec §1.1): a verified task is a done claim the gate verified, after the harness's checks, that the grader graded pass; never the gate's verdict alone
bar.test: exact one-sided McNemar (sign test on the discordant tasks), K better than no-recovery
bar.unit: the task, paired across the two arms
notShown: fewer than 5 discordant tasks: reported as underpowered at n, with the discordant count
the pack's pre-registration hash does not match a committed pre-registration
secondary: the same split by faulted and unfaulted tasks
cost per verified task (token-derived estimate; a null cost is unknown, never 0)
guardrails: any gate miss (a verified verdict on an attempt the grader grades fail or ungradable) halts the K run; the pack is reported as halted with that trial and goes back to the lead
every attempt is in the attempt ledger with its outcome; the check refuses a pack whose attempt count does not match the harness's
K rows record gate.corrections on, so a K row relabelled myco-gate is refused as R1 evidence
a K result is never reported as a corrections result, and a corrections result never as a K result

baseSurface: C1+I if I's bar is shown, otherwise C1; both arms call the gate at the end of every attempt; one step budget per trial, shared across attempts
assignment: seeded, interleaved (task, arm) order from seeds.assignment, arms alternating in ABBA blocks per task (spec §1.3); seeds.bootstrap is reserved for the secondary ratio intervals and is not used by the bar
harness: Claude Ultra (Claude Code), the same harness and model for both arms; $0 Anthropic API
evidence: experiment rows, never R1 evidence unless the lead rules otherwise (spec §3.4); simulated rows never count (§3.5)
